Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art-direction exploration board for an adult humorous evolution simulation video game. Landscape 3:2.
Create THREE alternative original male host designs, numbered columns, under small title "KITCH". He has outlaw tech entrepreneur energy: weathered virile face, unpredictable charisma, weird and sometimes stupid, intensely enthusiastic about evolution, affable but rough. Original fictional character, not a real person's portrait. Ambiguous age around 45–60.
Style: beautifully composed premium CHUNKY PIXEL ART. LARGE VISIBLE SQUARE PIXELS, limited color ramps, strong clusters, crisp nearest-neighbor edges, effectively 480x320 logical art enlarged. Bold silhouettes and expressive angular faces, economical shading. Adult arcade character art. No smooth digital painting or realistic illustration.
Composition: three equal columns on near-black background, thin subtle separators. Each column has a very large expressive waist-up portrait and a small full-body silhouette below, with generous breathing room.
01 label "CORSAIRE": sunburned skin, long angular face, crooked grin, crow's feet, messy swept-back dark hair with silver temples, heavy mustache joining short pointed salt-and-pepper goatee. Wiry broad shoulders, dark plum sleeveless tropical shirt with sparse cream fossil motif, chest hair, trousers and boots, amber aviator sunglasses pushed onto forehead. Old broadcast microphone repaired with orange tape. Absolutely delighted that something has gone wrong. Confident loose posture.
02 label "PREDICATEUR": tall lean swaggering man, receding swept-back silver mane, thick mustache and short goatee, cream suit jacket over black open-neck shirt, cheap oversized amber signet ring, microphone and theatrical raised palm, conspiratorial grin. Disreputable late-night science televangelist, no religious symbols.
03 label "GARAGISTE": stockier build, muscular forearms, wide crooked nose, tousled dark-gray hair, scruffy goatee and heavy mustache, faded orange work vest over black sleeveless shirt, crude branching evolutionary tree tattoo on one arm, microphone, hand on hip. Brilliant foolish confidence, an engineer who fixes life with pliers.
Palette warm skin, cream highlights, plum shadows, oxidized teal, burnt orange accents. Black dominates. Restrained color, no neon cyberpunk. Text only "KITCH", "01 CORSAIRE", "02 PREDICATEUR", "03 GARAGISTE" in clean small pixel type.
All three eccentric and adult with imperfect faces and simple animation-ready features. No cute babyfaces, no sinister mad scientist, no scenic background, no weapons, no watermark. Strong art direction and readable pixel clusters.

Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Asset: six-expression PIXEL ART production direction sheet for KITCH, the adult male host of an evolution simulation game.
Reference image: ONLY column 01 CORSAIRE is the character identity reference. Ignore columns 02 and 03. Preserve his long weathered sunburned angular face, swept-back dark hair with silver temples, thick black mustache with small pointed gray goatee, amber aviators on forehead, open sleeveless plum fossil-print shirt and chest hair. Original eccentric middle-aged outlaw tech host.
Requested change: radically SIMPLIFY the reference into MUCH LARGER PIXEL CLUSTERS suitable for a real game portrait. Six consistent head-and-shoulders portraits in a precisely aligned 3 columns x 2 rows grid, same head size, same view and pose, each visibly drawn on approximately 64x72 source pixels then enlarged without interpolation. Single-square eye highlights, broad solid skin planes, chunky angular hair blocks, only 4 skin shades, roughly 20-color total palette. Do not render an intricate high-resolution painting with a pixel filter. No fine stippling. Deliberately coarse bold pixel art, expressive adventure-game portraits.
Six expressions in reading order:
1 "BONIMENTEUR": sly crooked closed-mouth grin, one eyebrow raised, eyelids narrow.
2 "EXTASE": eyes insanely wide, open laughing mouth, delighted that the experiment went off the rails, joyfully stupid and virile, not cute.
3 "MAUVAISE FOI": looking sideways, suspiciously innocent tight little smile, eyebrow lift.
4 "RESPECT": mouth slightly open, genuine startled impressed expression, both eyebrows high.
5 "CATASTROPHE": suddenly tense face, one sweating square, jaw open, his own stupidity has caught up with him.
6 "COMPLICE": one-eye wink and toothy asymmetric grin, inviting the player into his bad plan.
Background flat near-black. Fine muted teal grid separators with generous margins, tiny cream pixel labels underneath each portrait, title "KITCH / EXPRESSIONS" at top. Amber and cream accents, dark plum shadows. Consistent costume, skull, facial hair, lighting and proportions across all six. Adult irreverent humor with warmth, not sinister, no cute or bland dad face. No additional props or text paragraphs, no watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: finished concept screenshot of a 16:9 PC evolution simulation game, 1920x1080 composition. This is a restrained actual game screen, not a poster or an elaborate arena.
Reference image: use ONLY the CORSAIRE host in left column for character identity: tanned angular weathered face, salt-pepper goatee and mustache, swept-back dark hair silver temples, amber glasses on forehead, plum open sleeveless fossil shirt. Render him as a simplified low-resolution chunky pixel portrait.
Layout: near-black screen, more than 75 percent of the screen dedicated to one very large sparse BLACK rectangular simulation board. Board has ONLY a fine muted teal outline, no visible grid, no terrain, no scenery. Inside approximately 70 LARGE simple abstract circular colored dots dispersed organically and unevenly with generous negative space. Each dot solid cyan, yellow, magenta, or lime, about 22–28 screen pixels diameter at 1920x1080. Crisp pixel-stepped circular edges with at most one tiny highlight, no faces, limbs or creature shapes. Single population field, not teams or rival territories. No motion trails or particles obscuring dots.
Top compact horizontal dialogue strip: small pixel bust of Kitch on left, grinning joyfully wide-eyed, thin orange accent rule, cream readable pixel type reading exactly "KITCH" and "IL BOUGE ENCORE. J'ADORE CE PETIT CON." The top strip uses around 16 percent of screen height, board takes dominant center and bottom. Keep portrait small so the board is the main attraction.
Very restrained corner UI: small title "EVOLUTION WARS" at top left, tiny amber "EN COURS" at top right, simple pause icon. Bottom outside board only "PERIODE 01" and a thin understated progress indicator. No invented stats, no scores, no team labels, no opponents, no cards or upgrade controls.
Palette near-black, muted teal outlines, cream text, burnt-orange UI accents. Large saturated gameplay dots remain immediately legible. Warm expressive human host against abstract analytical playfield. Retro PC game with visible square pixels, minimal functional interface, generous negative space, mature comic attitude, refined composition. Avoid glossy sci-fi HUDs, metal frames, laboratory background, dense widgets, big mascot covering gameplay, photorealistic faces.
